limits: Desktop comparison diagram bottom is outside its viewport.
Mobile entry lower predictions/actions are outside that entry capture.
Mobile screenshots concentrate on the four-point card; center and four cards are not simultaneously shown at narrow width.
Tables are read across separately scrolled views, not all columns simultaneously; all-pixel right-column wheel was not performed.
Pixel colour chips are explanatory CSS RGB values, not device colour reproduction measurements.
All numerical coverage comes from independent saved values and DOM; images do not establish simultaneous readability of all100samples.
